method: Targeted review of four existing units against cached AQA 8464 4.1.3 and RP02 plus established adequacy standard. No full Biology discovery repeated; unit decisions based on actual teaching, targeted assessment/feedback, skills, tier and practical content, not question counts.

units.title: Diffusion
units.teachingRevision: Net diffusion and rate factors retained/extended; oxygen, carbon dioxide and urea-to-plasma/kidney context explicit. Animal lungs/gills/intestine and plant roots/leaves linked to area, short paths and maintained gradients. Existing SA:V examples retained with an equal-volume shape comparison.
units.assessment: New q01 tests movement/rate factors, q02 SA:V calculation/application, q03 comparative exchange surfaces/unfamiliar context and q07 transport comparison; retained bio2-surface and aqa-cell-cube-ratio/exchange-limit remain.
units.answersFeedback: Full model answers and explicit marking criteria with targeted misconception feedback; writing uses honest existing self-assessment. Quantitative questions include units, signs and intermediate calculation explanations.
units.skillsAndPractical: MS1c/5c ratios/area/volume and biological modelling/application are supported. No counter-current-detail requirement added.
units.tier: Shared Foundation/Higher requirements; effective Foundation, unsure and Higher availability tested. Other boards/courses unchanged.
